description:
🏡 Think you’ve found the perfect home?
If it’s in an HOA neighborhood, don’t sign yet! ✋
Ask these 6️⃣ key questions first — the wrong HOA can cost you 💸, stress you out 😩, and limit your freedom 🚫.

👇 Smart buyers always ask:

1️⃣ How much are the monthly fees & what do they cover?
💰 Fees can vary a lot — are you paying for a pool, lawn care, or just rules?

2️⃣ How often do the fees go up?
📈 A “good deal” now might double later — check past increases!

3️⃣ Any special assessments coming?
⚠️ If reserves are low, surprise charges could be around the corner 🧾

4️⃣ What are the design or renovation rules?
🎨 Can you paint your house, build a deck, or plant a tree? Better ask!

5️⃣ Are rentals allowed?
🏘️ Some HOAs ban short-term rentals or limit long-term leases — it matters!

6️⃣ What’s the HOA’s financial health?
📊 Ask for their budget + reserve study. Red flags = low savings & big repairs

🔑 Bottom line:
✅ A solid HOA protects your home + boosts value
❌ A bad one = stress, $$ loss, & no freedom

🙋‍♀️ If you’re buying in an HOA community — let’s talk!
We’ll help you ask the right questions, avoid red flags, and protect your future 🛡️
